senses.gloss:
आह्वा आह्वा, i. e. आ-ह्वे + आ, f. A name.
 --Comp.

आह्वय आह्वय, i. e. आ-ह्वे + अ, m.
 1. Betting, Man. 8, 7.
 2. As latter part of a comp. adj., Called, e. g.
 रामायण- called Rāmāyaṇa, Rām. 1, 4, 1.
 गजाह्वय, गजसाह्वय, नागसाह्वय and वारणसाह्वय, i. e. -स-आह्वय, Called by the name of an elephant, i. e. Hāstinapura from हस्तिन्, an elephant, and पुर, a town, MBh. 3, 270 and 9, and 1, 1786.
 गण्ड-साह्वया, f. The name of a river, probably = Gaṇḍakī, MBh. 3, 14230.
 चक्र-साह्वय, m. The ruddy goose, Anas casarca Gm., Rām. 4, 51, 38; cf. साह्वय.
 --Comp.
ऽआह्वयन -आह्वयन, i. e. आ-ह्वे + अन, n. Latter part of comp. adj., रथ-अन्ग-, called after a part of a cart, i. e. चक्र-वाक, The name of a bird, from चक्र, a wheel, Rām. 2, 95, 11.

आह्वान आह्वान, i. e. आ-ह्वे + अन, n.
 1. Calling, summons, Pañc. iii. d. 44.
 2. An invocation, Man. 9, 126.
 3. A challenge, Rām. 4, 13, 40.
